answer: Price each identity to a scarce berth at a congested wharf: a limited external docking slot no wallet mints in bulk. Standing then ripens like a pearl, one layer per epoch, only as an agent climbs a knoll of peer-audited work co-signed by several already-established peers from separate funding clusters. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet must buy a distinct wharf berth per head (linear cost) and age each pearl through the whole climb, while an honest agent moors once; clones never gather the cross-cluster signatures, so their standing stalls at the foot of the knoll.
